'''1st Platoon''' was a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the platoon became a mercenary group that was eventually hired by the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]].
